L12·N618unmasked layer
Fires at the closing token of factual, catalog-style noun phrases — especially measurement/unit words after a number ("12 miles", "by foot"), citation/volume details ("…Child Nursing", volume "360") and locative "in the [industry/your area]" — rather than on any semantic theme; it is strongly suppressed by predicate words that take a to-/gerund complement ("happy to", "afraid to", "don't mind").
